SELECT
FROM ai_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role = 'assistant' AND status = 'streaming' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_messages SET feedback = #{feedback}, feedback_reason = #{feedbackReason}, feedback_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role = 'assistant'
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(role = 'assistant' AND feedback = 'like') AS likeCount, SUM(role = 'assistant' AND feedback = 'dislike') AS dislikeCount, SUM(role = 'assistant' AND feedback IS NOT NULL) AS feedbackCount, SUM(role = 'assistant' AND status = 'cancelled') AS cancelledCount, SUM(role = 'assistant' AND status = 'complete') AS answerCount FROM ai_messages WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
